title: Auxiliar de saúde bucal - asb
description:
Olá! Sou Gabriela, dentista, tenho um consultório odontológico com meu irmão, Gustavo. Estamos à procura de uma/um ASB/ TSB (Auxiliar de saúde bucal / Técnico de saúde bucal) para colaborar na nossa rotina de atendimentos. Somos uma empresa com grandes sonhos a serem realizados! E espero encontrar aqui uma/um colabora/colaborador disposto a somar e crescer conosco. O cargo de ASB/ TSB para nós é de extrema importância, já que é onde o profissional tem contato direto com o paciente.

Nesse cargo tem responsabilidades no auxílio aos dentistas nos atendimentos, organização/preparação de sala, organização de estoque, realizar processos de esterilização, receber e conferir trabalhos de laboratório. Obrigada pelo interesse na vaga, espero te conhecer em breve! VAGA: Auxiliar de Saúde Bucal (ASB) Área Clínica / Central de Planejamento Estamos buscando uma ASB organizada, responsável e com experiência em rotina clínica para compor nossa equipe. Responsabilidades:

Auxiliar o dentista durante os procedimentos. Preparar sala, montar e desmontar mesa clínica. Realizar todo o processo de esterilização (limpeza, empacotamento, autoclave e controle de validade). Organizar e controlar o estoque de materiais. Receber, conferir e organizar trabalhos de laboratório (próteses, alinhadores, etc.). Higienização de equipamentos e salas entre atendimentos. Acolher e orientar pacientes quando necessário. Cumprimento dos protocolos de biossegurança.

Requisitos:

Formação em ASB + CRO ativo. Conhecimento em biossegurança e esterilização. Organização, responsabilidade e boa comunicação. Atenção aos detalhes e postura profissional. Diferencial: experiência prévia em clínica odontológica ou controle de estoque/laboratório. Perfil buscado: Pessoa proativa, cuidadosa, ágil e que goste de trabalhar em equipe. Bonificações em caso de atingimento de metas, plano de saúde, cesta R$ 300,00.

title: Ports and shipping specialist
description:
Senior Non-Key Expert – Ports and Shipping Specialist

About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project "Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006."

The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal's geopolitical offer.

The contract will involve the mobilisation of experts for technical assistance missions worldwide, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific.

The intended start date is January 2027, with an implementation period of 48 months.

In this context, NTU International is seeking a highly qualified Senior Non-Key Expert – Ports and Shipping Specialist to support technical, policy, institutional and investment-related assignments in the maritime and inland waterways sectors.

Key Responsibilities

Supporting the identification, preparation and implementation of maritime, port and inland waterways infrastructure projects. Conducting feasibility studies, technical assessments, project design reviews and investment-related analyses. Supporting port and logistics master planning, connectivity planning and multimodal transport integration. Advising on port infrastructure development, maritime transport services and inland waterways systems. Supporting procurement, tendering, implementation supervision, operation and maintenance planning. Promoting sustainable maritime transport and port decarbonisation measures. Supporting energy efficiency, electrification of port operations, shore-side electricity, renewable fuels and emissions reduction initiatives. Advising on green port infrastructure, circular economy approaches and environmental performance. Supporting climate resilience, disaster risk reduction and sustainability considerations in maritime infrastructure. Contributing to policy, regulatory and institutional reforms in the maritime sector. Supporting capacity building for public authorities, port authorities, operators and other sector stakeholders. Promoting European standards, technical practices and sustainability requirements in partner countries. Supporting stakeholder coordination involving public authorities, port authorities, operators, contractors, supervising engineers, IFIs and development partners.

Qualifications and Skills

Master's degree or equivalent diploma in maritime engineering, maritime sciences, port engineering, transport engineering, logistics, or another directly related discipline. Excellent knowledge of the maritime and inland waterways sectors, including ports, maritime transport, inland waterways transport and related policies and good practices. Good understanding of sustainable transport, infrastructure development, climate resilience and environmental and social considerations. Knowledge of development aid delivery methods. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Excellent computer skills.

General Professional Experience

At least 15 years of general professional experience in the maritime sector. Proven experience managing complex assignments involving multiple stakeholders, including public authorities, port authorities, operators, contractors, supervising engineers and development partners. Proven professional experience across the project cycle of maritime infrastructure and services investments, including feasibility studies, detailed design, tendering/procurement support, implementation, operation and maintenance planning. Experience applying international and European standards and good practices related to maritime transport and port infrastructure, including technical quality, safety, environmental and social compliance, climate resilience and sustainability.

Specific Professional Experience

At least 7 years of professional experience in the planning, design, supervision or management of maritime and/or port infrastructure and services. At least 3 years of proven professional experience in sustainable maritime transport and port decarbonisation, including areas such as energy efficiency, electrification of port operations, shore-side electricity, green port infrastructure, renewable fuels, emissions reduction measures, circular approaches, climate resilience and environmental performance of ports. Professional experience related to the G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment in the maritime sector, including feasibility studies, project design, port and logistics planning, safety, environmental and social considerations, maintenance, procurement, connectivity, interoperability and master plan development.

Assets

Professional experience in developing countries (in situ); Professional experience in providing support to governance / capacity building in the maritime sector; Professional experience with the EU rules and procedures.

Language Requirements

English proficiency at C1 level is mandatory. French at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset. Spanish at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.

Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Selected experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance missions in partner countries globally. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Analista fiscal sênior (impostos diretos e indiretos)
description:
China Mobile International Brazil is seeking a

Tax Executive

to join our growing team in Brazil. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and supporting the company's tax activities, ensuring accurate tax calculations, compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, timely submission of tax obligations, and proper management of tax-related documentation and processes.

The Tax professional will work closely with internal departments, external accounting firms, clients, vendors, and government authorities to ensure tax compliance, support business operations, and identify solutions to tax-related matters.

Work Location:

Paulista Area, São Paulo Work Model:

100% On-site

Job Responsibilities

Perform tax calculations and verify assessed taxes, including ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, DIFAL, IRPJ, CSLL, FUST, FUNTTEL, and withholding taxes, requesting corrections whenever necessary. Prepare and submit ancillary tax obligations, such as GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, DIRF, among others. Collaborate with external accounting firms throughout the tax assessment process by providing accurate and timely information and documentation.

Support internal and external audits by gathering, reviewing, and providing all required documentation and information. Keep tax clearance certificates up to date to support participation in public tenders and ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements. Issue, review, and submit to clients invoices related to services, goods, rentals, imports, exports, and telecommunications. Record and approve incoming invoices, verifying tax information and fiscal classifications, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.

Prepare tax payment slips, such as DARF, DARE, DARJ, and GNRE, among others, in coordination with the central payments team. Validate tax and fiscal information related to REIDI. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting closings and directly perform the tax closing process, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of the information. Maintain relationships with government authorities, including the Receita Federal, SEFAZ, City Halls, and other relevant government agencies.

Provide tax support to other departments by addressing and clarifying tax-related questions from employees, vendors, and clients. Participate in internal projects by providing tax guidance and proposing solutions to ensure tax compliance and operational efficiency. Prepare and submit IBGE reports on an annual basis, DICI reports on a monthly basis, and CODEF reports on a semi-annual basis.

Coordinate the tax and fiscal procedures related to the nationalization of imported services and products, ensuring compliance with applicable Brazilian tax and regulatory requirements. Organize and maintain reports and records of all invoices issued by the company. Coordinate and follow up on tax-related matters with related parties and internal/external stakeholders.

Requirements Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field. Previous experience with direct and indirect tax assessment, including ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL, and other applicable taxes. Proficiency in preparing and submitting ancillary tax obligations, including GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, and DIRF. Solid knowledge of fiscal classification, including CFOP, NCM, and CST. Experience issuing, reviewing, and recording incoming and outgoing invoices. Experience with tax and fiscal processes related to imports and exports is preferred. Up-to-date knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its potential impacts on the company's operations. Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Note:

Position offered shall be determined by the candidate's years of relevant experience and skillsets. All personal data collected will be used for recruitment and employment-related purpose only.

qualificações

formação completa como técnico de enfermagem com registro ativo no conselho regional de enfermagem e desejável certificação complementar em assistência direta a pacientes. experiência em cuidados diretos a pacientes com domínio de técnicas de enfermagem controle de sinais vitais e apoio a procedimentos médicos. conhecimento básico em princípios de enfermagem e medicina aplicados ao ambiente clínico incluindo noções de farmacologia administração de medicamentos e biossegurança. habilidade para comunicação clara e acolhedora trabalho em equipe organização de rotina e atenção a detalhes garantindo segurança e conforto de pacientes. diferenciais incluem experiência prévia em clínicas ou hospitais cursos de atualização em boas práticas de enfermagem e disponibilidade para aprender protocolos específicos da Contour Clinique.

Curso Técnico de Enfermagem completo. COREN ativo e regular. Experiência prévia em clínica estética, centro cirúrgico, pós-operatório ou procedimentos corporais. Conhecimento no manuseio, preparo e acompanhamento de equipamentos utilizados em tecnologias corporais. Experiência com protocolos de biossegurança, assepsia, organização de sala e controle de materiais. Experiência no acompanhamento de cirurgias e procedimentos médicos será um diferencial. Boa comunicação, postura profissional, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes. Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.

Preparo e organização de equipamentos corporais antes dos atendimentos. Noções de parâmetros, ponteiras, higienização e conservação dos aparelhos. Acompanhamento de procedimentos corporais conforme protocolo da clínica. title: Director of strategic partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, Fin Techs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships

WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

8+ years of B2 B enterprise partnerships experience Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, Di Di, Mercado Pago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, i Food or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia

WHAT WE OFFER

Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate Remote-first with regional travel as required Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM

MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Field application engineer
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Nossa cliente é uma pioneira em rápido crescimento no espaço de robótica agrícola, revolucionando a indústria agrícola ao projetar e construir máquinas agrícolas autônomas e avançadas. Ao utilizar visão computacional de ponta e aprendizado de máquina, sua tecnologia permite que os agricultores entendam e gerenciem campos em nível de planta a planta. Apoiada como uma subsidiária independente de um dos gigantes globais de máquinas agrícolas mais respeitados do mundo, eles combinam o ambiente ágil e dinâmico de uma startup de alta tecnologia com o enorme poder de escalonamento de um líder da indústria. Sua missão é melhorar a produção de alimentos global, aumentar a rentabilidade agrícola e proteger o meio ambiente, reduzindo drasticamente o uso de pesticidas.

Sobre o Papel

Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Aplicação de Campo prático baseado no Brasil para ajudar a desenvolver, apoiar e manter máquinas agrícolas "inteligentes" de próxima geração. Neste papel, você será a ponte entre o campo e a equipe de engenharia. Você realizará testes de produtos em campo, solucionará sistemas eletromecânicos complexos e fornecerá o feedback crucial necessário para impulsionar o desenvolvimento contínuo do produto. Esta é uma oportunidade de início imediato com um potencial empolgante para viajar para os Estados Unidos durante a entressafra brasileira.

Responsabilidades

Testes em Campo: Realizar testes de campo de hardware, software e visão de máquina em máquinas agrícolas mecatrônicas, fornecendo relatórios de execução e documentação detalhados. Suporte Técnico: Coletar dados de campo, solucionar, diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos no local. Colaboração Interfuncional: Servir como o elo vital entre clientes, gerenciamento de produtos, agronomia e engenharia para comunicar as necessidades reais dos usuários. Documentação: Auxiliar as equipes de engenharia na criação de documentação abrangente do produto, guias do usuário e materiais instrucionais. Gestão de Sistemas: Rastrear e gerenciar problemas técnicos recorrentes desde a identificação inicial até a resolução final. Logística e Configuração: Realizar configuração prática, manutenção, calibração e transporte de equipamentos de teste em campo conforme necessário.

Qualificações

Habilidades Linguísticas: Fluência profissional completa em inglês e português (escrito e verbal). Educação: Diploma de bacharel ou experiência prática equivalente em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Agricultura ou uma disciplina técnica relacionada. Experiência: Mais de 2 anos de experiência apoiando, solucionando problemas ou mantendo sistemas eletromecânicos agrícolas complexos (grandes máquinas).

Habilidades Necessárias

Diagnóstico Técnico: Forte capacidade de diagnosticar sistemas complexos que abrangem componentes de hardware, software e mecânicos. Comunicação e Mentalidade: Excelentes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente com uma atitude colaborativa e orientada para a equipe. Mobilidade: Carteira de motorista válida com um histórico de direção seguro e uma forte disposição para viajar frequentemente para campos agrícolas.

Habilidades Preferenciais

Familiaridade com ambientes Linux e programação básica de scripts. Experiência em projetar e executar Testes de Verificação de Design (DVT). Habilidades básicas de programação/scripting em Python. Familiaridade com software CAD (por exemplo, Solid Works).

Faixa de Pagamento e Pacote de Compensação

Totalmente Equipado: Todas as ferramentas, equipamentos especializados e veículos de trabalho são fornecidos pelo empregador. Viagens Cobertas: Reembolso de 100% para todas as despesas de viagem relacionadas ao trabalho. Exposição Global: Oportunidades únicas para colaboração internacional e viagens para a sede nos EUA.

Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades

Estamos comprometidos com a diversidade e inclusão em nosso local de trabalho e incentivamos candidaturas de todas as pessoas, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica protegida por lei.

Field Application Engineer – Smart Agricultural Technology

Location: Brazil (Field-based with opportunities for US travel)

Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing pioneer in the agricultural robotics space, revolutionizing the farming industry by designing and building advanced, autonomous farm machines. By utilizing cutting-edge computer vision and machine learning, their technology enables farmers to understand and manage fields at a plant-by-plant level.

Backed as an independent subsidiary of one of the world's most respected global agricultural machinery giants, they combine the agile, fast-paced environment of a high-tech startup with the massive scaling power of an industry leader. Their mission is to improve global food production, increase farming profitability, and protect the environment by dramatically reducing pesticide use.

We are seeking a hands-on Field Application Engineer based in Brazil to help develop, support, and maintain next-generation "smart" farm machines. In this role, you will be the bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will carry out in-field product testing, troubleshoot complex electro-mechanical systems, and provide the crucial feedback needed to drive continuous product development.

This is an immediate-start opportunity with exciting potential to travel to the United States during the Brazilian off-season.

Key Responsibilities

As a Field Application Engineer, your primary focus will be supporting smart machinery performance directly in the field:

In-Field Testing: Carry out hardware, software, and machine vision field tests on mechatronic agricultural machinery, providing detailed execution reports and documentation. Technical Support: Collect field data, troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues on-site. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the vital link between customers, product management, agronomy, and engineering to communicate real-world user needs. Documentation: Assist engineering teams in creating comprehensive product documentation, user guides, and instructional materials. Systems Management: Track and manage recurring technical issues from initial identification to final resolution. Logistics & Setup: Perform hands-on setup, maintenance, calibration, and transport of field-testing equipment as required.

What We Are Looking For

Minimum Requirements:

Language Skills: Full professional fluency in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal). Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Agriculture, or a related technical discipline. Experience: 2+ years of experience supporting, troubleshooting, or maintaining complex agricultural electro-mechanical systems (large machinery). Technical Troubleshooting: Strong ability to diagnose complex systems spanning hardware, software, and mechanical components. Communication & Mindset: Excellent customer-facing skills with a collaborative, team-oriented attitude. Mobility: Valid driver's license with a safe driving record, and a strong willingness to travel frequently to agricultural fields.

Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred but not required):

Familiarity with Linux environments and basic script programming. Experience in designing and executing Design Verification Testing (DVT). Basic programming/scripting skills in Python. Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., Solid Works ).

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

This is an active, hands-on role in an outdoor environment. You should be comfortable standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing in various weather conditions (hot and cold). Ability to frequently lift/move items up to 25 pounds (and occasionally up to 50 pounds). Strong visual acuity (including color vision and depth perception) to work with advanced camera and machine vision systems.

What's on Offer

Competitive Compensation Package with a highly collaborative, supportive, and forward-thinking work culture. Fully Equipped: All tools, specialized equipment, and work vehicles are provided by the employer. Travel Covered: 100% reimbursement for all work-related travel expenses. Global Exposure: Unique opportunities for international collaboration and travel to US headquarters.

title: Retail credit risk manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work TM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They're among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We're looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need

Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English

Nice to have

Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with Com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

- Promover o uso das políticas corporativas da Emerson no ambiente de projetos do PMO. Quem você é: Você assume a responsabilidade pelos resultados dos outros. Você age com rapidez e decisão em situações imprevisíveis e que alteram os fatos. Você demonstra grande iniciativa em situações difíceis e é excepcional em identificar e aproveitar oportunidades. Você facilita um diálogo aberto com uma ampla variedade de colaboradores e partes interessadas. Você transmite mensagens de forma clara, convincente e concisa. Para este cargo, você precisará: - Formação em engenharia Elétrica, Aeronáutica, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, de Controle e Automação, Química; - 5 anos de experiência, preferencialmente na indústria de instrumentação e/ou controle e automação de processos; - Conhecimento em desenhos técnicos; - Conhecimento em Office 365; - Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais/internacionais; - Inglês avançado para reuniões técnicas com equipes e clientes de outros países; - Local de trabalho: Sorocaba-SP. Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam: - Espanhol; - Conhecimento em Sistema Oracle; - Conhecimento em CRM Cloud; - Experiência com atendimento ao cliente. Nossa cultura e compromisso com você: Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios. Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. title: Supervisor de operações de vendas
description:
Supervisor de operações de comerciais 商务运营主管

Posicionamento do Cargo

Responsável pela construção e gestão do dia a dia do sistema de operações comerciais da CDHORIZON Brasil, coordenando oportunidades de negócio, cotações, contratos, pedidos, entregas, locação, faturamento, conciliação e acompanhamento de recebíveis.

Este cargo tem foco em gestão de equipe, gestão de processos, dados de gestão do negócio e coordenação interdepartamental, não sendo o desempenho individual de vendas o principal critério de avaliação.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Gestão de Processos Comerciais

Estabelecer e aprimorar normas, processos e formulários de operações comerciais; Padronizar os processos de cotação, contrato, pedido, entrega, faturamento e conciliação; Impulsionar a padronização, sistematização e gestão em ciclo fechado das atividades comerciais.

2. Gestão de Contratos e Pedidos

Organizar a revisão comercial, assinatura, recolhimento e arquivamento de contratos; Verificar preços, prazos de pagamento, tributos, transporte e principais cláusulas comerciais; Gerenciar aprovação, alteração, suspensão e encerramento de pedidos; Sinalizar riscos em preços especiais, prazos de pagamento estendidos e cláusulas fora do padrão.

3. Coordenação da Execução de Projetos

Coordenar vendas, ativos, serviços, logística e financeiro na conclusão da entrega dos pedidos; Acompanhar entrada de equipamentos, início de locação, troca de máquina, encerramento e retirada; Tratar atrasos na entrega, divergências de faturamento e reclamações de clientes, entre outras exceções; Impulsionar o fechamento de pendências em clientes e projetos prioritários.

4. Gestão de Faturamento e Contas a Receber

Organizar o faturamento mensal de locação, liquidação, emissão de notas fiscais e conciliação com clientes; Garantir consistência entre contrato, pedido, registro de entrega e dados de faturamento; Apoiar o financeiro no acompanhamento de pagamentos de clientes e recebíveis em atraso; Impulsionar as vendas na elaboração e execução de planos de cobrança de valores em atraso.

5. Gestão de Operações de Vendas

Gerenciar o funil de vendas, lista de clientes e projetos prioritários; Acompanhar o progresso de oportunidades, status de cotações e previsão de fechamento; Organizar revisões de oportunidades-chave e retrospectivas do processo de vendas; Analisar taxa de conversão de oportunidades, motivos de perda de negócios e desvios na execução de vendas.

6. Dados de Gestão do Negócio e Colaboração Interdepartamental

Estabelecer relatórios semanais, mensais e painéis de gestão das operações comerciais; Monitorar recolhimento de contratos, execução de pedidos, precisão de faturamento, cobertura de conciliação e progresso de recebimentos; Identificar anomalias no negócio e propor soluções; Atuar como principal ponto de coordenação entre vendas, ativos, serviços, cadeia de suprimentos e financeiro.

7. Gestão de Equipe

Responsável pela divisão de tarefas, treinamento e gestão de desempenho da equipe comercial; Estabelecer padrões de gestão de contratos, pedidos, faturamento e documentação; Aumentar a eficiência de execução e a capacidade de resolução de problemas da equipe.

Requisitos:

Chinês como idioma de trabalho aceitável; Mais de 3 (três) anos de experiência em operações comerciais; Boas habilidades de comunicação; Ensino superior completo.

title: Human resources manager
description:
Why Valmont

We're Here to Move the World Forward.

Valmont impacts millions of people around the world every day, yet they might not realize the many ways. Our technology is helping feed the growing population, supplying the world with more reliable energy and access to renewables, enhancing connectivity in remote and urban locations to create a sustainable future and so much more. Simply put, Valmont is advancing agricultural productivity and reimagining vital infrastructure to make life better.

Join a Fortune 1000 company that respects hard work, honors diversity and invests in our employees as we focus on creating the world of tomorrow, today. We are the modern workforce. Are you ready to move the world forward? Apply now.

Brief Summary of Position:

The Human Resources Manager is responsible for leading the full spectrum of Human Resources activities for the business unit, acting as a strategic business partner to leaders while ensuring operational excellence and compliance with corporate policies and local legislation. This role drives organizational effectiveness by leading talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, payroll oversight, employee relations, leadership development, performance management, succession planning, workforce planning, labor relations, compliance, and employee engagement initiatives. The position also partners closely with corporate HR Centers of Excellence and business leadership to align people strategies with organizational objectives. The HR Manager ensures compliance with labor legislation, corporate governance standards, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) requirements while fostering a high-performance culture focused on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and employee development. The HR Manager will lead and develop the local HR team, ensuring high performance and capability building.

Essential Functions:

Strategic HR Business Partnership

Partner with business leaders to develop and execute people strategies aligned with organizational goals. Provide coaching and guidance to managers on leadership, organizational design, talent management, employee relations, and performance. Support organizational transformation, change management initiatives, and workforce planning. Develop and implement HR policies, procedures, and best practices aligned with corporate guidelines and local legislation.

Talent Management

Lead talent acquisition activities, including recruitment strategy, selection, onboarding, and workforce planning. Drive Performance Management, Talent Review, Succession Planning, Individual Development Plans (IDPs), and employee survey action planning. Coordinate leadership development initiatives and training programs to strengthen organizational capabilities. Manage internship and early career programs, ensuring development and succession pipeline.

Compensation, Benefits & Payroll

Oversee payroll administration, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and corporate standards. Manage salary structures, job evaluations, compensation reviews, incentive programs, and annual merit processes. Partner with Corporate Compensation on job grading and organizational structure. Review and optimize employee benefits programs considering market competitiveness and cost effectiveness. Manage the HR budget, headcount planning (AOP), labor costs, and workforce analytics.

Employee Relations & Labor Compliance

Monitor labor legislation and recommend proactive actions to minimize legal exposure. Partner with Legal to manage labor litigation and develop strategies to mitigate legal risk and financial exposure. Lead labor relations activities, including collective bargaining negotiations in partnership with Legal. Ensure full compliance with labor, social security, tax, and statutory obligations. Support investigations, disciplinary actions, conflict resolution, and employee engagement initiatives.

HR Operations & Compliance

Ensure compliance with payroll, timekeeping, attendance management, and statutory reporting. Monitor HR metrics and KPIs. Leverage HR analytics to drive data-informed decisions related to turnover, absenteeism, overtime, engagement, recruitment effectiveness, and organizational health. Maintain HR processes, systems, records, and documentation in accordance with internal controls and audit requirements. Support internal and external audits.

Health, Safety & Well-being

Partner with EHS leadership to promote a strong safety culture. Support occupational health initiatives, wellness programs, legal compliance, and workplace safety practices. Ensure HR processes align with Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) standards and corporate requirements.

Required Qualifications:

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or related field. Postgraduate degree or MBA is preferred.

Experience

Minimum of 7 years of progressive Human Resources experience. Experience in multinational manufacturing or industrial environments. Experience supporting senior leadership teams. Proven experience leading strategic and operational HR initiatives.

Technical Knowledge

Brazilian Labor Legislation (CLT) Payroll Administration and Labor Compliance Compensation & Benefits Performance Management Talent Acquisition Learning & Development Organizational Development Workforce Planning Employee Relations Labor Union Negotiations HR Analytics & KPIs Budget and Financial Management Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) HRIS systems and Microsoft Office

Languages:

Fluent English (mandatory).

title: Cross border tech compliance adviso
description:
Role Description The Cross Border Tech Compliance Advisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Valparaíso de Goiás, GO. This role focuses on advising SFAP community members and partner organizations on technology-related compliance requirements affecting cross-border finance and accounting activities. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring relevant regulations and standards, preparing guidance materials, and reviewing processes to ensure adherence to data protection, cybersecurity, and fintech compliance norms. The Advisor will collaborate with stakeholders to assess risk, recommend controls for technology platforms and tools, and support the implementation of compliant workflows. The role also involves conducting awareness sessions and drafting reports, policies, and procedures that are clear, practical, and aligned with applicable regulatory frameworks.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong knowledge of cross-border compliance, including regulatory frameworks relevant to finance, accounting, and technology-enabled services. Candidates should possess skills in technology risk assessment, data protection practices, and cybersecurity principles related to financial systems and digital platforms. Candidates should possess the ability to analyze complex regulations, interpret legal and technical requirements, and translate them into practical policies and procedures. Candidates should possess effective communication skills, including the capacity to prepare clear documentation, deliver training sessions, and engage with diverse stakeholders. Candidates should possess strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives. Relevant experience in compliance, audit, or advisory roles within finance, accounting, or fintech environments is beneficial. A bachelor's degree in law, finance, accounting, information systems, or a related field is preferred; professional certifications in compliance, risk management, or data protection are a plus. Familiarity with regional and international regulatory bodies, cross-border data transfer rules, and industry best practices in governance and ethics is advantageous.

title: Art center & events administrative support intern
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

The Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern provides administrative, scheduling, and operational support to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager in the coordination and execution of events across Graded.

A primary responsibility is to support reservations and scheduling for Art Center spaces, including the Black Box Theatre, Haddad Center, Art Gallery, classrooms, and other designated areas. The Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern also assists with event records, calendar updates, service requests, purchase orders, payment processes, event preparation, and on-site logistical support.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities

Art Center Reservations & Scheduling

Support reservations and scheduling for Art Center spaces. Review requests, check availability, identify scheduling conflicts, and maintain accurate reservation records. Enter and update approved reservations in Ev M and relevant school calendars. Communicate confirmations, changes, and space-use information to requesters. Follow up on missing information and escalate conflicts or exceptions to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.

Event Management System & Calendar Support

Provide administrative and logistical support for school events. Assist with event schedules, checklists, service requests, guest information, signage, and other operational materials. Coordinate routine requests with Maintenance, ICT, Cafeteria, Security, and other departments as needed. Maintain organized event records, files, spreadsheets, and supporting documentation. Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, payment requests, and process follow-up. Support faculty and staff with routine questions related to reservations and event procedures.

Event Coordination & Administrative Support

Assist with event setup and breakdown and help ensure spaces are ready for scheduled use. Support guest reception, registration, wayfinding, and other event-day activities as needed. Monitor assigned event spaces and report operational, maintenance, safety, or facility concerns. Help ensure spaces are properly reset following events. Support evening and weekend events when required and permitted within the internship schedule. Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, as well as with payment requests and follow-up throughout the process.

Art Center Space Readiness

Conduct routine checks of Art Center spaces in connection with scheduled reservations and events. Help ensure that reserved spaces are organized and ready for use. Identify and report concerns related to cleanliness, furniture, audiovisual equipment, maintenance, safety, or general facility conditions. Support the organization of event supplies, signage, materials, and other shared resources. Report discrepancies between approved reservations and actual space usage to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager. Assist in maintaining organized records related to Art Center space utilization and recurring operational needs.

Professional Practice

Work under the direction of the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager and collaborate professionally with different school departments. Maintain confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries with students. Comply with Graded's Child Safeguarding Code of Conduct, policies, and procedures. Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, organization, and a service-oriented approach. Perform other internship-related duties as assigned by the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.

Certifications and Education

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program eligible for a formal internship.

Experience

Previous internship, volunteer, university, or extracurricular experience involving events, administration, customer service, scheduling, or project support. Familiarity with calendars, spreadsheets, reservation systems, or event management tools.

title: Consultor de demanda - neurologia
description:
Descrição do Cargo: Como Consultor de Demanda especializado em Neurologia, você desempenhará um papel estratégico na identificação e no engajamento dos HCPs-alvo e na gestão do território sob sua responsabilidade.

Sua atuação será fundamental para apoiar o propósito da Multicare de melhorar e prolongar a vida dos pacientes, por meio da construção de relacionamentos de confiança, geração de valor para os profissionais de saúde e excelência na execução da estratégia do produto.

O objetivo é impulsionar a geração de demanda de maneira ética, sustentável e orientada às necessidades dos pacientes e dos profissionais de saúde.

Qualificações

Formação: Superior em Administração de Empresas, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, Farmácia, Biomedicina ou áreas correlatas.

Basico: Conhecimento sólido do sistema de saúde brasileiro, tanto público quanto privado, e do mercado farmacêutico.

Específicos: Compreensão das particularidades e desafios relacionados às doenças raras e/ou à neurologia, bem como capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Medical Affairs/MSL, Acesso, Operações e demais áreas envolvidas, contribuindo para o sucesso da estratégia do produto e, principalmente, para a jornada do paciente;

Experiência: Experiência prévia no setor farmacêutico, preferencialmente em posições relacionadas à geração de demanda, promoção de produtos farmacêuticos e relacionamento com neurologistas, neurologistas pediátricos e outros profissionais de saúde envolvidos na jornada do paciente.

É desejável experiência comprovada em:

geração de demanda; planejamento e execução de visitas; gestão de território e contas; relacionamento e engajamento com HCPs; acesso ao mercado de saúde brasileiro; atuação nos sistemas público e privado de saúde; produtos de alta complexidade, neurologia e/ou doenças raras.

Atribuições e Responsabilidades:

Planejar, personalizar e executar jornadas de engajamento para HCPs-alvo, considerando suas necessidades e preferências e utilizando adequadamente os conteúdos e canais de interação disponibilizados pela companhia. Construir relacionamentos profissionais sólidos e sustentáveis com HCPs e demais stakeholders estratégicos, buscando estabelecer uma colaboração de longo prazo e gerar valor para os clientes, pacientes e para a Multicare. Proporcionar uma experiência de excelência e centrada no cliente, compreendendo suas necessidades, seu ambiente de saúde e os desafios relacionados à jornada do paciente. Utilizar de forma estratégica as fontes de dados e informações disponíveis para segmentar, priorizar e revisar continuamente o território, as contas e os planos de interação com clientes. Desenvolver e executar planos de território e de contas, estabelecendo prioridades, objetivos, indicadores e ações necessárias para maximizar o potencial de cada região sob sua responsabilidade. Identificar oportunidades e barreiras relacionadas ao diagnóstico, tratamento, acesso e jornada do paciente, compartilhando os insights relevantes com as áreas internas responsáveis. Compartilhar continuamente percepções e insights dos clientes com os stakeholders internos pertinentes, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de conteúdos, campanhas, estratégias e planos de interação relacionados ao produto e à sua indicação. Trabalhar de maneira integrada com equipes multifuncionais, especialmente Medical Affairs/MSL, Acesso, Marketing e Operações, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções que atendam às necessidades identificadas no mercado. Desenvolver e manter conhecimento aprofundado sobre o produto, sua indicação, o cenário terapêutico, a jornada do paciente, o ambiente competitivo e as particularidades do território sob sua responsabilidade. Contribuir para a geração de demanda de forma responsável, sustentável e ética, respeitando rigorosamente as indicações aprovadas, as políticas internas da Multicare e todas as normas regulatórias e de compliance aplicáveis. Monitorar sistematicamente os resultados e indicadores de performance de seu território, identificando desvios, oportunidades e ações necessárias para o atingimento dos objetivos estabelecidos. Representar a Multicare perante médicos, instituições e demais stakeholders de maneira profissional, ética e compatível com os valores e padrões de excelência da companhia. Agir permanentemente com integridade, transparência e respeito no relacionamento com clientes, pacientes, colegas e parceiros.

PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS

Buscamos profissionais ambiciosos, comprometidos e orientados a resultados, que desejem integrar um time de alta performance, atuando em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e estratégico.

Procuramos pessoas com forte capacidade de execução, maturidade profissional, senso de responsabilidade e disposição para assumir protagonismo na gestão de seu território.

Em um modelo de gestão de contas e territórios, o Consultor será responsável por liderar sua região com visão estratégica, disciplina de execução e foco em resultados, promovendo um elevado nível de engajamento com médicos e demais stakeholders.

Esperamos uma atuação pautada por excelência, ética, compliance, colaboração multidisciplinar e foco permanente no paciente, contribuindo para ampliar o acesso a terapias inovadoras em neurologia e para consolidar a Multicare como um parceiro de confiança dos profissionais e instituições de saúde.

title: National sales director (brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)

Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.

Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation. Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners. Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery. Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach. Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with product, R& D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively. Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.

Qualifications

A. Experience

Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market. Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred. Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes. Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen. Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

We Offer

Competitive compensation package. Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential. Full support from global headquarters in product, marketing, and technical resources.

About Hi-Road Food Technology

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. Committed to becoming the preferred partner in the global baking industry, we dedicate ourselves to providing customers with innovative, safe, and delicious food solutions.

With our strong independent R& D capabilities, Hi-Road meticulously sources world-class raw materials and employs advanced production technologies. Our comprehensive quality control system ensures the consistent excellence of our diverse product portfolio, which includes:

- Dairy and non-dairy toppings

- Premium fruit preparations

- Chocolate products

- Bakery creams and margarine compounds

- Flavor sauces

- Food flavors and additives

Through continuous innovation and stringent quality standards, we strive to deliver exceptional value and culinary inspiration to our partners worldwide

title: Learning & development expert
description:
Job Summary:

The Learning Expert is responsible for applying employee training programs, conducting training needs analysis, and developing engaging learning content. This role ensures smooth training logistics, maintains training records, and supports the continuous improvement of L& D initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Training Program Application

Schedule, organize, and deliver training programs through lectures, workshops, videos, e-learning, and blended formats. Apply training logistics, including scheduling, venue bookings, facilitator coordination, and employee enrollment. Maintain and update the Learning Management System (LMS) and training records. Handle administrative duties such as tracking attendance, sending reminders, and managing training budgets.

2. New Employee Orientation Facilitation

Design, update, and facilitate engaging onboarding programs for new hires. Collaborate with HR and department leaders to ensure a smooth transition for new employees. Continuously improve trainings based on feedback and evolving company needs.

3. Training Needs Analysis & Evaluation

Conduct surveys, interviews, and performance assessments to identify skill gaps. Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, quizzes, and KPIs (e.g., completion rates, performance improvement). Adjust training programs based on data insights to enhance engagement and knowledge retention.

4. Content & Training Material Development

Create and update training manuals, guides, job aids, and digital resources for employee learning. Develop interactive content (e-learning modules, videos, quizzes, presentations). Ensure materials comply with company policies and industry standards.

5. Training Delivery & Facilitation

Conduct engaging live and virtual training sessions for employees at all levels. Use diverse training methods (role-playing, simulations, discussions) to maximize learning. Provide post-training support to reinforce key concepts.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Partner with department heads to align training with business goals. Support ad-hoc Learning initiatives (leadership development, new employees training, etc.). Promote a culture of continuous learning through newsletters, LMS updates, and recognition programs.

7. Qualifications & Skills:

Experience: 7+ years in Learning, training application, or HR, including facilitation and content creation. Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (written and spoken). Technical Skills (Preferred/Nice-to-Have): Familiarity with LMS platforms and e-learning tools and knowledge of MS Office (Power Point, Excel) and video training software. Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management abilities, Engaging facilitator with excellent presentation and communication skills. Analytical mindset to assess training effectiveness and adapt programs.

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (Pw D). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

description:

Se você busca projetos desafiadores e disruptivos, a KAVAK é o seu lugar.

Modelo de trabalho e local :

Presencial - Escala 6x1 - das 9h as 17h20 ou 10h40 às 19h Local de Trabalho: São Paulo ou Barueri

Missão dessa posição :

Responsável por realizar o atendimento presencial aos clientes nas lojas Kavak, conduzindo-os com excelência por toda a jornada de venda de veículo do cliente. Atua em negociações de modelo competitivo, educando o cliente sobre o modelo de negócio da empresa, com foco na experiência, fidelização e entrega de resultados.

Descrição de Atividades :

Realizar atendimento presencial consultivo aos clientes em loja; Registrar informações e interações nos sistemas (Netsuite e Salesforce); Conduzir o cliente pela jornada de compra e venda com clareza, assertividade e rapidez; Educar o cliente sobre o modelo de negócio e diferenciais Kavak; Garantir a integridade de equipamentos, ferramentas e estrutura da loja; Atingir metas de indicadores como reserva, conversão, oferta imediata e NPS; Relacionar-se com stakeholders internos (vendas, logística, operações); Participar ativamente dos rituais diários (arrancada, all hands, reuniões mensais).

Requisitos para candidatura :

Ensino Médio completo (Ensino Superior cursando será considerado diferencial); Conhecimentos sobre o setor automotivo (Diferencial); Perfil comercial; Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e foco em experiência do consumidor; Conhecimento básico/intermediário em ferramentas como Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Netsuite, Salesforce.

Habilidades que buscamos :

Realizar atendimento consultivo, com escuta ativa e empatia; Comunicação clara, objetiva e influente; Capacidade de adaptação e gestão de múltiplas ferramentas digitais; Organização e controle de processos administrativos de venda; Capacidade de alcançar metas com orientação para resultados. Colaboração e trabalho em equipe no ambiente de loja

O que a Kavak te proporciona:

Assistência Médica e Odontológica para você e seus dependentes Well Hub (Gym Pass) : Nossa plataforma de bem-estar, que proporciona atividades físicas e cuidados com a saúde mental. Vale-Refeição e/ou Alimentação: Crédito depositado no Cartão Flash, para você escolher onde e como utilizar. Auxílio Mobilidade ou Vale Transporte : Flexibilidade para que você escolha o benefício que melhor se adapta ao seu dia a dia. Estacionamento Gratuito no Local: Para quem prefere vir de carro, oferecemos estacionamento sem custo. Transporte Fretado (sem desconto): Transporte fretado à disposição, proporcionando mais conforto e segurança no trajeto. Seguro de Vida: Segurança adicional para você e sua família. Day Off de Aniversário: Celebre seu dia com uma folga exclusiva. Desconto para compra de carros : você pode escolher o carro seminovo ou usado dos seus sonhos, dentro do inventário da Kavak, com desconto exclusivo para Kavakes e ainda contar com 4 revisões a um valor simbólico, de acordo com nossa política vigente.

Sobre a Kavak

A Kavak iniciou a revolução no mercado automotivo em 2016, criando uma plataforma baseada no uso de dados e tecnologia que compra, recondiciona e vende carros usados pela internet ou nas dependências da empresa (hubs), com todas as garantias de segurança e confiabilidade, além das melhores opções de financiamento. Após quatro anos de operação, a Kavak se tornou a primeira empresa unicórnio da história do México e uma das startups mais valiosas da América Latina.

title: Sales director, latam (brazil)
description:
Sales Director, LATAM (Brazil)

Reports To: Head Of Media Sales & Service, LATAM

Location: Brazil , Remote (São Paulo)

About us

Broadsign is a leading programmatic ad tech company on a mission to make buying, selling, and delivering out-of-home media easier than ever. Our platform powers the world's most successful OOH and retail media businesses while enabling agencies and brands to seamlessly plan and execute dynamic OOH campaigns across the globe. Come light up the world as a Sales Director.

Position Summary

Your day-to-day will vary but your mission is simple; as a key member of our Programmatic Team, you will be taking full responsibility for business development activities by educating buyers on the new opportunities brought forth by our products. Your patch will consist of media buyers from agencies, brands and DSP partners. You'll put your sales experience to use by determining client needs and recommending optimal programmatic DOOH proposals and supporting agency-wide agreements.

Of course, if this role speaks to you, you're someone who has;

5-10 years sales experience in the media world; you understand agencies and what advertisers care about Proven understanding of the digital programmatic world and/or the programmatic digital out-of-home ecosystem Interest in engaging with new buyers by introducing them to the benefits of programmatic DOOH and the innovative advertising opportunities via the Broadsign programmatic stack Excellent presentation skills - you know how to craft a pitch Strong organisational skills You have the ability to manage multiple tasks and perform well under pressure Great communication and collaborative approach with teammates This is a primarily remote role; however, we believe face-to-face connection drives the best results. You will be expected to make a best-effort approach to conducting in-person client meetings. To support your success, you will have full access to We Work spaces. Travel will primarily be within Brazil for client meetings, with occasional travel throughout LATAM for industry and company events. This role requires professional fluency in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is highly advantageous.

What we bring to the table

Health & Dental Insurance: Supplemental private medical and dental coverage for you and your dependents. You'll also have access to unlimited online mental health support through Better Help for you and your family. Wellness & Remote Fund: R$ 3,000 annual flexible budget for home office, wellness, or internet expenses Paid Time Off: Statutory 30 calendar days of paid rest after 12 months, plus the mandatory 1/3 vacation bonus, 5 "floater" days, 2 paid volunteer days, and 3 paid training days per year! Daycare Assistance: Monthly financial support/reimbursement for early-childhood daycare ( Auxílio-Creche ) Family Support: Parental leave salary supplement. Growth Opportunities: Training & development opportunities with a yearly budget to support professional growth.

At Broadsign, we value the varied social identities that make up our community. Our promise is to be an inclusive employer and partner, open to learning, with thoughtful strategies and practices that amplify the different voices of our industry.

title: Sales support
description:
Job Responsibilities:

Manage and oversee client contracts, ensuring proper execution of agreed processes and compliance with deadlines and contractual terms. Act as the main interface with clients and suppliers, ensuring alignment of information and maintaining high-quality relationships. Manage contractual and commercial issues, proposing solutions and leading negotiations to resolve deviations. Handle client collections, monitoring outstanding items and working closely to ensure timely payment regularization. Receive and review supplier documents (e.g., invoices), ensuring compliance with contracts and purchase orders. Process and track payment requests in internal systems, ensuring proper workflow through to completion. Work closely with the finance team to ensure payments are processed within agreed timelines. Manage the registration and maintenance of clients and suppliers in the ERP system (IBOSS), ensuring data accuracy and integrity. Prepare, review, and control operational documents such as COF (Contract Order Form) and VOF (Vendor Order Form). Coordinate with internal teams (finance, sales, solutions, and operations) to ensure proper information flow and adherence to deadlines. Monitor project timelines and status, ensuring clear and proactive communication with clients and stakeholders. Support the commercial team in structuring solutions and engaging with clients, contributing to opportunity development and closure. Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure full understanding of projects and efficient execution. Identify opportunities for process improvement and propose actions to enhance efficiency and quality. Act with autonomy in managing activities and serve as a reference for contract operations topics.

Job Requirements:

Bachelor's degree. Relevant experience in operational, administrative, or commercial support roles. Experience in contract management and monitoring. Experience interfacing with clients and suppliers, with strong communication and negotiation skills. Experience with operational processes related to billing, collections, or payment flows. Knowledge of ERP systems and proficiency in Microsoft Excel (intermediate level). Organized and analytical profile, with autonomy to manage tasks and solve problems. Advanced to fluent English, with the ability to communicate in a corporate environment. Availability to travel as required by the company.

title: Auxiliar de expedição e logística
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Operacional e Expedição

Sobre o Papel

Realizar a separação rigorosa de itens, garantindo 100% de acuracidade em relação ao pedido.

Responsabilidades

Separação e Conferência (Picking & Packing): Realizar a separação rigorosa de itens, garantindo 100% de acuracidade em relação ao pedido. Acondicionamento: Embalar produtos utilizando materiais adequados ao tipo de carga, visando a otimização de espaço e a proteção total contra danos no transporte. Gestão de Etiquetas: Emitir e aplicar etiquetas de identificação, códigos de barras e rótulos de transporte de forma legível e organizada. Gestão de ERP: Registrar todas as movimentações (entradas, saídas e transferências) no sistema interno, zelando pela integridade dos dados. Inventários: Executar contagens cíclicas diárias e participar ativamente de inventários gerais para garantir que o saldo físico seja idêntico ao saldo do sistema. Recebimento: Conferir notas fiscais de entrada versus mercadoria física, reportando imediatamente qualquer avaria ou divergência de quantidade. Manutenção do Layout: Organizar o estoque por endereçamento. Manter o ambiente de trabalho limpo e funcional. Contato com Transportadoras: Acionar transportadoras parceiras, conferir o carregamento dos veículos e organizar a fila de coletas diárias.

Qualificações

Técnico em Logística será um diferencial.

Experiência

Mínimo de 6 meses em rotinas de armazém ou expedição.

Informática

Conhecimento básico/intermediário em Excel e vivência com sistemas ERP.

● Atenção aos Detalhes: Foco extremo para evitar erros de separação que geram custos de logística reversa.

● Proatividade: Capacidade de antecipar gargalos no processo de embalagem antes do horário de coleta.

● Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

● Resiliência: Capacidade de manter a qualidade sob pressão em períodos de alto volume.

Comprometemo-nos com a diversidade e inclusão em nosso local de trabalho.

title: Senior revenue accountant - us gaap & process automation
description:
Accounting Data Analyst — Revenue

As one of the top mobility companies in the world, we have been redefining the industry with innovative mobile technologies since 2013, driving us toward becoming a super app. Join us in our mission to combat global injustice.

We are looking for an experienced accounting professional with strong technical and data skills to join our global Accounting team. In this role, you'll prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and revenue data packages that keep our books accurate, auditable, and US GAAP compliant — while writing the SQL and building the automation that makes those processes scalable as we prepare for public company readiness.

You'll report to a US-based Revenue Accounting leader (Eastern Time) and partner daily with accounting, data, and payment reconciliation colleagues across the globe. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable posting a journal entry in an ERP and querying a data warehouse — and who gets energized by fixing broken processes, not just running them.

What You'll Do

Prepare complete, review-ready journal entries across revenue, accounts receivable, payment provider settlements, chargebacks/refunds, taxes, and intercompany — with full supporting detail for ERP posting Prepare account reconciliations, flux analyses, and supporting schedules for monthly, quarterly, and annual close Write and maintain SQL queries against our data warehouse to extract and validate the data behind accruals and ASC 606 revenue recognition Support payment service provider (PSP) reconciliations — validating settlement, refund, chargeback, and fee data across geographies and currencies, and flagging discrepancies Document processes end-to-end and support SOX readiness, responding to internal and external audit requests as the preparer with full traceability from source to output Identify manual, error-prone steps and automate them — including with AI-enabled tooling — partnering with Data Engineering, IT, and Fin Tech teams

What We're Looking For

~8 years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on journal entry preparation and month-end close ownership Accounting degree with CRC or equivalent professional qualification (CPA-equivalent) Solid working knowledge of US GAAP; hands-on ASC 606 revenue recognition experience is a major plus Strong SQL skills — able to write and adapt queries against large-scale data warehouses (Big Query or similar) Proficiency with an ERP system (Net Suite, SAP, Oracle or similar): chart of accounts, journal entry posting, validation, and drill-down analysis Experience supporting internal or external audits; exposure to SOX controls and documentation Fluent English — this role works daily with a US-based team during Eastern Time hours

Nice to Have

Big 4 or large multinational (Fortune 500-scale) background; IPO or public company readiness experience Industry experience with complex, high-volume revenue models (tech/marketplace, retail, media, manufacturing) Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) and scripting for automation

Who Thrives Here

Someone gritty and curious who gets into the weeds, asks questions, and comes with proposed solutions. We're moving fast toward a bigger goal: priorities pivot, hours can stretch during peak periods, and feedback is direct. If you like ambiguity, ownership, and building processes that didn't exist yesterday, you'll fit right in!

What we offer

Competitive compensation package Comprehensive medical insurance coverage. Meal allowance Dental Insurance Hybrid setting Opportunity for advancement and upward mobility within the organization, allowing for increased levels of responsibility and growth within the company
