title: Remote investment lawyer - brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side. Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion. Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Partner relationship manager
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we're on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: "We help people eat better, live better."

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.

About the position

As the Partner Management Manager, you will architect and manage high-impact partnerships that drive growth. You will serve as the primary business interface between Keeta and our key partners, building mutually beneficial relationships that create sustainable competitive advantage.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Partner Development: Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic business partners that align with Keeta's growth objectives. Design and structure framework partnership objectives that maximize value creation for all stakeholders.

2. Portfolio Performance Ownership: Own the outcomes and market development targets for your partner portfolio. Conduct strategic business reviews to track performance metrics and identify optimization opportunities.

3. Market Intelligence & Growth Strategy: Analyze market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and partner capabilities to inform strategic decisions. Develop data-driven recommendations for market penetration and partnership optimization.

4. Relationship Management & Business Enablement: Build executive-level relationships with key partner stakeholders. Provide strategic guidance and operational support to help partners achieve their business objectives.

Job Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, or related field.

Experience in B2 B partnership management, business development, or strategic account management experience.

Proven skills with experience managing complex commercial relationships.

Fluent English (written and verbal) for cross-border collaboration.

Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze financial metrics and drive profitability.

Background in on-demand delivery, e-commerce, or logistics partnership networks where are critical for scaling is preferred.

MBA or advanced degree with a focus on international business or emerging markets is a plus.

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (Pw D). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

title: Tax manager (english speaker)
description:
*Who We Are:

Sailun Group ( is one of the world's leading rubber technology and tire companies. Being the 10th largest manufacturer in the world, Sailun Group is offering a broad portfolio of passenger car, truck and bus as well as specialty tires. The brand Sailun is the fastest growing tire brand globally (2023) and among the Top Ten in sustainability perception. *Position Overview:

This role is responsible for managing all tax matters, ensuring full compliance with applicable regulations while supporting Sailun´s business growth. The position plays a key advisory role, providing guidance on tax-efficient business models, liaising with tax authorities to secure incentives or refunds, and coordinating with headquarters on reporting and global tax initiatives.

Work independently to resolve tax-related issues and take full ownership of local tax compliance. Proactively collaborate with business operations teams to advise on optimal business models from a tax efficiency perspective, including but not limited to contract reviews, business model structuring, logistics flows, and invoice issuance. Liaise with tax authorities and other relevant administrations to apply for tax incentives or refunds where applicable, supporting business development across Brazil. Actively participate in the development of Brazil's tax information system and the configuration of tax rules. Report local tax matters and issues regularly to the headquarters tax team. Assist headquarters and/or local agents in preparing Pillar II filings or registrations where necessary.

*Requirements:

Bachelor's degree or higher in Accounting, Taxation, or a related field. Minimum of 3 years of professional tax experience with strong technical knowledge. Experience in tax matters and within the automotive trading industry is a plus. Experience with launching a tax information system is a plus. Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in Mandarin is highly desirable. Proficient in financial software and advanced Excel skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

*Work location:

Rua Enxovia, 472 – 24th floor – Suite 2407 – São Paulo/S

*What We Can Offer:

Enter the tyre market industry and train with experienced individuals! A platform to raise your innovative ideas and bring them into realization, make your mark in the tyre industry and beyond; Being part of a rapidly growing company which strives for further success worldwide; Being immersed in a people-oriented culture built on trust and respect; Being part of a diverse, fun, high-spirited and empowered team and interacting with counterparts from other regions internationally and colleagues from varied disciplines; A commitment to train and develop you continuously throughout your career; A career path that allows you to demonstrate your full potential; Competitive compensation and benefits package and non-financial recognition to reward your dedication and achievements.

Sounds appealing to you? Don't hesitate to get in touch and send your CV to ran.zheng@ with your salary expectation and the earliest possible on board date.

description:

8+ years' experience in HR, with at least 3 years in a generalist or HR business partner capacity Superior/higher degree completed Strong knowledge of Brazilian labor law (CLT) and employment regulations is a must Strong background in HR Operations is a must Proven experience managing the full employee lifecycle independently Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) is a must Strong stakeholder management skills - able to influence and advise senior leaders Strong ethics, discretion, and judgment in handling sensitive matters Experience with employee engagement, L& D, and talent development Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision Strong analytical and problem-solving skills is a must Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Power Point) Experience in the tech or gaming industry is a plus Experience in using or developing AI solutions Team player with a collaborative mindset Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

description:

Conhecimento desejável da legislação portuária, carga perigosa, faltas e avarias e regulamento aduaneiro; Perfil profissional organizado e proativo, com sólida capacidade de liderança, planejamento e gestão de processos, orientado para resultados, excelência operacional e melhoria contínua; Desejável Excel avançado.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

Controlar a acuracidade de OCR e traçar ações para garantir que ela atinja os padrões determinados pela Receita Federal; Garantir junto aos encarregados de operações e ao especialista de equipamentos que todos os equipamentos e veículos em operação estejam em condições gerais de funcionamento e com as eventuais documentações /certificações em dia; Participar do estudo para implantação de medidas emergenciais, de acordo com as situações que possam ocorrer no desenvolvimento das atividades, de modo a buscar soluções eficazes e que não representem aumento de custo para o terminal; Realizar diariamente o diálogo de segurança, focando nos riscos inerentes da operação e garantindo o correto preenchimento do controle de presença; Interagir com a área de manutenção para garantir o melhor desempenho dos equipamentos; Difundir a sustentabilidade dentro de seu ambiente de trabalho. Difundir a sustentabilidade dentro de seu ambiente de trabalho; Cumprir e fazer cumprir o procedimento de amarração /desamarração, conforme treinamento; Executar outras atividades, caso haja necessidade imperiosa, com o mesmo grau de complexidade, de acordo com solicitações do Gestor da área e/ou recomendações do médico do trabalho; Cumprir com os procedimentos e instruções relativas à função, bem como as normas e procedimentos gerais da empresa; Garantir que o SGI alcance seus resultados pretendidos dentro de sua esfera de competência. Direcionar, engajar e apoiar os colaboradores para que contribuam para a eficácia do sistema, promovendo a cultura de segurança, a prevenção de poluição e o foco no cliente. Assegurar a provisão de recursos necessários para a execução segura, padronizada e eficiente das atividades operacionais sob sua responsabilidade; Assegurar cumprimento das diretrizes estabelecidas pela Política do SGI, atuando em conformidade com os procedimentos internos e legislações vigentes; É responsabilidade inerente ao cargo descrito relatar ativamente quaisquer desvios de qualidade, incidentes, condições inseguras ou impactos ambientais adversos, contribuindo para a eliminação de perigos, redução de riscos e para a melhoria contínua do SGI; Executar as rotinas visando o atendimento aos requisitos da atividade e a satisfação do cliente, zelando pela padronização e mitigação de falhas; Zelar pela própria integridade física e de terceiros, utilizar adequadamente os EPIs, cumprir as regras de segurança do trabalho e exercer o direito de recusa diante de riscos iminentes não controlados. Conta ponto Experiência como jogador ao vivo, seja reg ou profissional. Conhecer a cena local de poker e dos clubes. Inglês. Habilidade pra registrar bem em foto e vídeo. title: Remote commercial lawyer - brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Assistente de planejamento de demanda e controle da produção (pcp)
description:

Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site:.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Planejamento de Demanda e Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) para apoiar as rotinas de benefícios, controle de ponto, medicina do trabalho e processos admissionais.

Missão

Apoiar as rotinas das áreas de Planejamento de Demanda e Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP), contribuindo para a coleta, organização, atualização e controle de informações relacionadas a vendas, estoque, forecast, disponibilidade de produtos, planejamento de amostras, industrialização em terceiros e indicadores operacionais.

O cargo tem como foco dar suporte às análises e aos processos de planejamento, garantindo a confiabilidade dos dados, o cumprimento das rotinas estabelecidas e a integração das informações entre as áreas Comercial, Compras, Supply Chain, Operações, Logística, Qualidade, Produção Terceirizada e demais áreas envolvidas, assegurando o adequado planejamento e acompanhamento das operações produtivas e do abastecimento.

Desafios do Cargo

Apoiar a organização de dados de vendas, estoque e demanda com atenção aos detalhes e confiabilidade; Manter planilhas, relatórios, bases de dados e controles operacionais atualizados; Contribuir para o acompanhamento de indicadores como cobertura de estoque, ruptura, giro, produtos de baixo giro e disponibilidade; Apoiar a preparação de materiais e informações para reuniões de planejamento, forecast e S& OP; Atuar em interface com diferentes áreas internas, garantindo comunicação clara e acompanhamento das pendências; Aprender e aplicar rotinas, sistemas, ferramentas e processos relacionados ao planejamento de demanda; Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos controles e fluxos operacionais da área; Apoiar o planejamento e controle das produções realizadas em terceiros, acompanhando embarques, recebimentos e prazos de fabricação; Garantir o controle e acompanhamento do fluxo de envio e retorno de materiais destinados à industrialização em terceiros; Apoiar o planejamento e acompanhamento das amostras, garantindo disponibilidade, cumprimento de prazos e atendimento às demandas comerciais e técnicas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Apoiar a coleta, consolidação, atualização e conferência de dados de vendas, demanda, estoque, pedidos, disponibilidade de produtos e abastecimento. Atualizar planilhas, relatórios, dashboards, cadastros e controles operacionais em sistemas ERP, ferramentas de BI e plataformas internas. Acompanhar indicadores de planejamento e estoque, como cobertura, giro, ruptura, acuracidade, excesso, obsolescência, produtos críticos e itens de baixo giro. Apoiar o planejamento e o controle das produções realizadas por parceiros terceirizados, incluindo envio de matérias-primas, acompanhamento da fabricação, recebimento e atualização dos saldos. Monitorar atrasos, desvios, inconsistências e riscos de abastecimento, reportando as ocorrências às áreas responsáveis. Apoiar o planejamento e o controle de amostras, garantindo disponibilidade de materiais e atendimento aos prazos acordados. Manter organizados os históricos, documentos, registros, materiais enviados, materiais recebidos e estoques em poder de terceiros. Requisitos e qualificações

title: Ip lawyer (in-house, brazil)
description:
Hello!

We are looking for an experienced and proactive IP Lawyer to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.

This is a remote-first position, offering flexibility while working closely with our international legal and business teams. However, the role requires regular attendance at court hearings, enforcement actions, and raids in São Paulo. Therefore, candidates must reside in the city of São Paulo or its metropolitan area.

You'll work directly on protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands through a combination of civil, criminal, and administrative IP enforcement.

The position focuses on hands-on IP enforcement, including drafting and sending claims, managing pre-litigation negotiations, coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities, representing clients in civil and criminal proceedings, and recovering monetary compensation from infringers.

Who are we?

Brand Monitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries such as fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA, and Latin America, and we are now expanding our legal team in Brazil.

What you will do:

Identify and monitor IP infringements throughout Brazil; Draft and send cease-and-desist letters, legal claims, and negotiate settlements; Represent rights holders in pre-litigation, civil litigation, and criminal IP proceedings; Coordinate and participate in search and seizure operations (raids) and enforcement actions with local authorities (Police, Customs, Public Prosecutor's Office, regulatory agencies, etc.); Draft and file powers of attorney, affidavits, criminal complaints, petitions, and litigation documents; Build and maintain strong relationships with law enforcement agencies, courts, investigators, and service providers; Recover monetary compensation through settlements or court decisions; Support the company's legal and business operations in Brazil (contracts, compliance, office setup, banking, and corporate matters, as needed).

What we expect from you:

Law degree and admission to the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB); Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Intellectual Property (either in-house or at a law firm); Proven experience with IP enforcement, including: Civil litigation; Criminal IP matters, including search and seizure actions, criminal complaints, anti-counterfeiting investigations, and interactions with police and prosecutors; Experience coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities; Strong legal drafting, negotiation, and communication skills; Fluent Portuguese and professional English (written and spoken); Highly organized, proactive, and able to work independently in a global environment; Must reside in São Paulo (city or metropolitan area) due to the need for in-person attendance at courts, hearings, and enforcement operations.

What We Offer:

Work with top-tier global clients and international teams; Competitive salary; Opportunity to lead and shape Brand Monitor's legal operations in Brazil; Remote-first work environment with flexibility; Meaningful impact in the global fight against counterfeiting and intellectual property violations; Career growth within a fast-growing international legal-tech company.

Join Brand Monitor and help protect some of the world's leading brands while making a real impact in the fight against counterfeiting.

title: Crypto operations specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Supervisor de laboratorio industrial
description:
Supervisor(a) de Laboratório Industrial

O(a) Supervisor(a) de Laboratório Industrial será responsável por supervisionar, coordenar e garantir a qualidade das atividades realizadas no laboratório, atuando de forma estratégica e operacional para assegurar a precisão das análises, a confiabilidade dos resultados e a conformidade com as normas e os regulamentos aplicáveis.

Terá atuação próxima à equipe e aos processos industriais, promovendo a organização das rotinas, o desenvolvimento dos profissionais e a melhoria contínua dos procedimentos laboratoriais.

No dia a dia, será responsável por distribuir tarefas, acompanhar os turnos operacionais e avaliar o desempenho dos analistas e técnicos. Também deverá assegurar a confiabilidade das análises físico-químicas de matérias-primas, produtos em processo e produtos acabados, além de acompanhar a manutenção e a calibração dos instrumentos do laboratório.

Responsabilidades

Supervisionar e coordenar as atividades e rotinas do laboratório industrial; Garantir a qualidade dos processos e procedimentos laboratoriais; Gerenciar, orientar e desenvolver a equipe do laboratório; Distribuir tarefas, acompanhar os turnos operacionais e avaliar o desempenho dos analistas e técnicos; Assegurar a precisão e a confiabilidade das análises físico-químicas de matérias-primas, produtos em processo e produtos acabados; Elaborar relatórios, registros e demais documentações técnicas; Garantir a conformidade do laboratório com as normas e os regulamentos aplicáveis; Planejar e acompanhar as manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos instrumentos e equipamentos laboratoriais; Planejar e controlar a calibração dos instrumentos analíticos e acessórios do laboratório; Elaborar, revisar e implementar Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POPs); Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de segurança, incluindo o uso adequado de EPIs, o descarte correto de resíduos e a limpeza do ambiente; Trabalhar em interface com as áreas de Produção, Qualidade, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho.

Qualificações

Ensino Superior completo em Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas; Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Química (CRQ); Experiência mínima de 6 meses em rotinas de laboratório industrial e liderança de equipes.

Diferenciais

Experiência com gestão de equipes e indicadores laboratoriais; Conhecimento em elaboração e revisão de POPs; Vivência com auditorias, normas de qualidade e melhoria contínua.

A combinar.

Período integral.

title: Gerente de investimentos | mesa multimercado global
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a)

Gerente(a) de Investimentos

para liderar nossa Mesa de Investimentos Multimercado Global com reporte para nosso Diretor de Multimercado. Procuramos um profissional com sólida experiência em mercados financeiros nacionais e internacionais, alocação de ativos, gestão de risco e construção de portfólios multimercado.

Essa posição terá papel estratégico na definição das teses de investimento, gestão das equipes de análise e gestão, relacionamento com investidores e acompanhamento das tendências macroeconômicas globais, garantindo a geração consistente de retorno ajustado ao risco.

Principais responsabilidades Liderar a estratégia de investimentos dos fundos multimercado, com foco em mercados globais e diferentes classes de ativos. Definir direcionamentos de alocação em renda fixa, renda variável, moedas, commodities, derivativos e investimentos alternativos. Coordenar e desenvolver equipes de gestores, analistas e economistas, promovendo excelência técnica e alta performance. Conduzir análises macroeconômicas e geopolíticas que suportem a tomada de decisão de investimentos em âmbito internacional.

Participar ativamente da construção e revisão das teses de investimento, monitorando sua aderência aos objetivos dos fundos. Definir e supervisionar políticas de risco, liquidez e exposição, garantindo alinhamento às diretrizes regulatórias e de governança. Liderar os Comitês de Investimento, apresentando recomendações estratégicas e direcionamentos para os portfólios. Monitorar continuamente a performance das carteiras, propondo ajustes táticos e estratégicos para otimização dos resultados.

Desenvolver relacionamentos com bancos globais, corretoras, gestores internacionais, investidores institucionais e demais parceiros estratégicos. Identificar oportunidades de investimento em diferentes geografias e setores econômicos, antecipando tendências e mudanças de mercado. Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e estratégias de investimento voltadas ao mercado local e internacional. Garantir o cumprimento das políticas de compliance, governança e gestão fiduciária da gestora. Representar a companhia perante investidores, órgãos reguladores, parceiros e demais stakeholders do mercado financeiro.

Requisitos Experiência Experiência consolidada na gestão de fundos multimercado, hedge funds ou estratégias de alocação global. Histórico comprovado em gestão de portfólio e tomada de decisão em diferentes ciclos de mercado. Forte conhecimento de macroeconomia global, alocação de ativos e instrumentos financeiros. Experiência na liderança de equipes de investimentos e participação em comitês executivos. Vivência no relacionamento com investidores institucionais, family offices, fundos de pensão e distribuidores.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Mercados globais de renda fixa, renda variável, moedas, commodities e derivativos. Gestão de risco, liquidez e construção de portfólios. Produtos estruturados e estratégias de hedge. Ferramentas quantitativas e análise financeira avançada. Regulamentação aplicável à indústria de fundos e gestão de recursos.

Idiomas Inglês fluente ou avançado (obrigatório). Espanhol será considerado diferencial.

Competências Comportamentais Visão estratégica e pensamento de longo prazo. Alta capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão sob pressão. Liderança inspiradora e desenvolvimento de equipes. Capacidade de atuar em ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados. Excelente comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders internos e externos. Perfil empreendedor, colaborativo e orientado à geração de valor para os investidores.

O que esperamos desse profissional Buscamos um líder capaz de transformar cenários complexos em oportunidades de investimento, combinando visão macroeconômica global, rigor analítico e disciplina de gestão de risco para gerar resultados consistentes aos investidores no longo prazo.

title: Business development & marketing
description: About i QIYI i QIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences. Role purpose Support i QIYI's expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision. Key responsibilities 1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant i QIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent i QIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America. 2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the i QIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations. Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred. Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage. Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Technical sales engineer
description:
We are looking for a customer-focused Technical Sales Engineer to join Quortex.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales teams and customers to understand business challenges, design technical solutions, and demonstrate the value of Quortex technologies. You will act as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process, helping customers evaluate architectural options and achieve their business objectives.

This position combines technical expertise, customer engagement, solution design, and business consulting. You will work with telecommunications operators, broadcasters, media companies, streaming providers, and technology partners to design innovative video delivery and streaming solutions.

Professional proficiency in English is required. Portuguese and Spanish language skills are highly desirable to support customer engagement and business growth across the region.

What you'll do

Customer Engagement and Solution Consulting

Act as a technical advisor and subject matter expert for customers and partners. Partner with Sales teams to develop customer strategies and solution approaches. Understand customer business and technical requirements and translate them into tailored solutions. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, from technical teams to executive decision-makers. Communicate the business value, expected return on investment, and strategic benefits of proposed solutions. Conduct technical discovery sessions and architecture workshops.

Solution Design and Technical Leadership

Design and present solution architectures across the Quortex portfolio, including Saa S, public cloud, private cloud, hybrid, and on-premises offerings. Recommend scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures aligned with customer objectives. Design solutions covering end-to-end video processing, delivery, monitoring, and distribution workflows. Advise customers on cloud video workflows, scalability, content delivery, recording, and monitoring. Translate customer requirements and market feedback into recommendations that can contribute to product roadmaps. Support customers with architectural decisions and video workflow migration to the cloud.

Pre-Sales Support

Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Lead and support Proof of Concept activities, translating customer needs into clear technical use cases and success criteria. Participate in RFP and RFI processes. Prepare technical proposals and responses to customer requirements. Create solution documentation, architecture diagrams, and supporting technical materials. Troubleshoot technical issues related to Linux, networking, video systems, and system integrations during demonstrations and Proofs of Concept.

Business Development and Market Engagement

Contribute to territory planning and account strategies. Support lead-generation activities through customer engagement, webinars, presentations, events, and technical content. Collaborate with partners, resellers, systems integrators, and other ecosystem stakeholders to develop joint opportunities. Represent Quortex at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events when required. Participate as an exhibitor or speaker at relevant industry events, depending on experience and business needs.

Internal Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales teams. Provide customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights to support product development. Help connect customer needs with product capabilities and future roadmap opportunities. Share technical knowledge and best practices across the organization.

What we're looking for

Mandatory Technical Experience

Knowledge of end-to-end video workflows, including:

Ingest

Encoding and transcoding

Statistical multiplexing, or statmux

Adaptive Bitrate Streaming, or ABR

Over-the-Top delivery, or OTT

Direct-to-Home distribution, or DTH

Primary distribution

Cable distribution

Experience troubleshooting Linux environments, networking, and system integrations. Knowledge of public and private cloud architectures applied to video workflows. Experience designing or deploying cloud-based video solutions. Ability to conduct Proofs of Concept, from understanding customer requirements to defining the proposed solution and success criteria. Ability to translate customer needs and technical feedback into product and roadmap recommendations. Experience participating in RFP or RFI processes and preparing technical proposals. Understanding of video processing, packaging, compression, content delivery, and streaming technologies. Experience with live and on-demand video architectures. Ability to design and explain technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Desirable Technical Experience

Knowledge of advertising technologies and video monetization models. Experience with Server-Side Ad Insertion, or SSAI. Familiarity with Server-Guided Ad Insertion, or SGAI, and Dynamic Ad Insertion, or DAI. Experience with hybrid environments and the migration of video workflows to the cloud. Knowledge of broadcast and media standards, including:

SMPTE ST 2110

SCTE-35

SCTE-224

Experience with Content Delivery Networks. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes. Experience with video compression, packaging, encoding, DRM, and content delivery. Understanding of cloud-based media workflows and recording solutions. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and cloud-native architectures.

Business and Customer Skills

Ability to understand customer challenges and translate them into practical technical solutions. Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Experience discussing both technical requirements and business outcomes with customers. Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong organizational, prioritization, and project coordination skills. Commercial awareness and an understanding of Saa S business models. A customer-focused approach supported by strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams. Experience working with partners, resellers, systems integrators, or other ecosystem stakeholders is advantageous.

Differentiators

The following experience is not required but would be considered an advantage:

Participation in large-scale projects as a Solutions Architect or in a similar technical leadership role. Programming or scripting skills. Experience representing an organization at trade shows as an exhibitor, speaker, or technical presenter. Cloud architecture certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or another recognized provider. Additional training or certifications in video technologies, broadcast engineering, networking, or cloud architecture.

Preferred Background

We welcome candidates from a range of sectors, including:

Media and Entertainment Streaming Platforms Telecommunications Cloud and Saa S Companies Video Technology Vendors Systems Integration and Consulting

title: Analista ambiental sênior - licenciamento ambiental
description:

Local: Belo Horizonte, MG

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Ambiental Sênior para integrar nossa Gerência Corporativa de Licenciamento Ambiental. Procuramos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em licenciamento ambiental no setor de mineração , elevado conhecimento técnico e capacidade de atuar de forma estratégica na condução de processos de licenciamento ambiental, análise crítica de estudos ambientais e interface com órgãos ambientais, consultorias especializadas e unidades operacionais.

A posição terá papel fundamental no suporte técnico às operações de mineração, garantindo a qualidade dos estudos ambientais, o atendimento aos requisitos legais e regulatórios e o alinhamento das estratégias de licenciamento para os empreendimentos da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

Conduzir e acompanhar processos de licenciamento ambiental de empreendimentos minerários, garantindo o cumprimento dos requisitos legais, condicionantes ambientais e prazos regulatórios; Desenvolver, em conjunto com a Gerência de Licenciamento Ambiental, estratégias de licenciamento para novos projetos, expansões e operações de mineração; Realizar análise crítica, revisão técnica e validação de estudos ambientais, como EIA/RIMA, RCA/PCA, PRAD, entre outros documentos exigidos pelos órgãos ambientais; Avaliar metodologias, premissas e resultados dos estudos elaborados por consultorias especializadas, assegurando a qualidade técnica das entregas e propondo melhorias quando necessário; Atuar como referência técnica junto às unidades operacionais, prestando suporte na condução dos processos de licenciamento e no atendimento às demandas ambientais dos sites; Participar e conduzir reuniões técnicas com órgãos ambientais, consultorias e equipes multidisciplinares, representando a empresa em temas relacionados ao licenciamento ambiental; Monitorar o andamento dos processos de licenciamento, identificando riscos, oportunidades e desvios, propondo ações para garantir o cumprimento dos cronogramas; Elaborar pareceres técnicos, relatórios, respostas a ofícios e demais documentos necessários à condução dos processos de licenciamento. title: Mars program — mba leadership
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international brand of Meituan, the world's leading food delivery platform. Guided by the mission of \"helping people eat better and live better,\" we bring 15 years of Meituan's technology and operational expertise to global markets. Since launching in 2023, we have grown from Hong Kong to the Middle East and Brazil — building real value for users, merchants, and delivery partners in every community we serve.

About Mars Program

Mars Program is Keeta's flagship leadership accelerator — a strategic investment in the next generation of business leaders for Brazil. This is not a traditional hire. We are looking for high-potential talents who want to build a long-term career in Brazil, understand the food delivery business end-to-end, and grow into future leaders of this organization.

You will be assigned to one of the four core pillars of our business — Merchant, Consumer, Delivery, and Business Analytics — gaining a comprehensive, hands-on understanding of what it takes to build and scale a world-class food delivery platform.

What You'll Do

Your responsibilities will evolve across business areas, and may include:

Drive merchant acquisition, activation, and retention strategies to grow Keeta's supply-side ecosystem in Brazil. Design and execute consumer growth and retention initiatives, tailoring strategies to local user behavior and market dynamics. Optimize delivery operations — improving efficiency, rider experience, and fulfillment quality in the Brazilian market. Conduct business analysis to translate data into strategic insights, supporting key decisions across functions. Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects, collaborating with local and global teams to solve real business challenges.

What We're Looking For

Education: Full-time international MBA required. We seek candidates who have completed or are completing a full-time MBA program, bringing a global perspective and the academic foundation to lead in a complex, fast-growing market. Background: Experience in consulting, finance, tech, fast-moving consumer goods, or management trainee programs is a strong fit. Candidates from outside the industry with demonstrated high potential are equally welcome. Language: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Mindset: Humble, hands-on, curious, resilient — excited by the ambiguity of building something from scratch, not just managing what's already there.

Why Join Mars Program

High Starting Point — a dual recognition of your past achievements and future potential. This is our commitment to attracting top talent. End-to-End Business Exposure — specialize in one of our four core pillars. Build the holistic view and foundational logic of the food delivery business that most professionals spend a decade trying to piece together. Executive Mentorship & Visibility — Enter a high-visibility talent pool with direct access to senior leadership, intensive coaching, and exposure to real strategic decisions. World-Class Methodology — Benefit from Meituan's 15 years of deep industry know-how and scientific operating frameworks, now being applied to crack one of the world's most exciting new markets.

Work Location: São Paulo, Brazil.

Onboarding Target: September 2026

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (Pw D). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

Excel/planilhas em nível avançado. Visão de negócio: capacidade de transformar números em recomendação de compra.

Salário CLT de R$ 6.000 a R$ 8.000, conforme experiência. Benefícios: VT, VR/VA, plano de saúde Posição nova, com autonomia para estruturar a área e reporte direto à diretoria.

As a comprehensive workplace manager, you will be responsible for establishing the administrative system for large‐scale integrated workplaces, leading team management, and conducting in‐depth alignment with corporate headquarters administration.

3)Plan annual activity calendar and oversee delivery of regional cultural events.

1.2 Expense & Budget Oversight

1.4 Vendor Management

2)Manage relationships with key regional vendors and drive continuous service improvement.

2)Consolidate regional system requirements and partner with headquarters Administration to iterate platform functionalities.

1.9 Communication & IT Infrastructure Support

1.10 Team Management

3)Directly manage administrative teams including Supervisors and Specialists, covering recruitment & selection, performance management and talent development.

title: Senior vip relationship specialist, brazil
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and driven Senior VIP Relationship Specialist to join our VIP team in Brazil. In this senior role, you will serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for our high-value clients in the region. You will be responsible for elevating the customer experience, fostering long-term client loyalty, and leading localized initiatives to drive business success and market share within the Brazilian and broader LATAM crypto ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Management & Acquisition: Drive client acquisition and deliver high-touch relationship management for a dedicated portfolio of premium institutional and high-net-worth (HNW) clients in Brazil. Relationship & Engagement: Build strong rapport and trust with existing VIP clients through frequent, personalized, and sustained communication, ensuring high retention and platform loyalty. Process Optimization: Take ownership of designing and optimizing key customer service processes and systems tailored to the local market, establishing management rules, and tracking the life-cycle status of key accounts. Data-Driven Analysis: Analyze client trading behaviors, identify unspoken or sophisticated needs, and prepare comprehensive key customer analysis reports to inform localized product and service strategies. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the strategic liaison between Brazil VIP clients and internal stakeholders (Product, Compliance, Operations, and Tech teams) to deliver optimal, seamless, and compliant service solutions.

Qualifications

Proven Track Record: A well-established client network in Brazil/LATAM, including institutional clients, high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs), family offices, private banking clients, brokers, or futures institutions. Industry Experience: Direct experience working within crypto trading platforms, digital asset exchanges, or fintech pioneers is highly advantageous. Financial Background: Minimum of 4-6 years of prior experience in sales, account management, or client services within international financial institutions, commercial/private banking, or asset management. Language Proficiency: Native or bilingual fluency in Portuguese (both written and spoken) is mandatory, along with professional proficiency in English for cross-border corporate communication. Adaptability & Resilience: Proven ability to thrive under pressure, manage tight deadlines, and excel in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment. Crypto Passion: Demonstrates a deep enthusiasm for the web3 and cryptocurrency industry, with a sharp understanding of the latest trends, regulatory shifts, and innovations in the Brazilian market.

title: Técnico de instalação, treinamento e suporte

Formação técnica em Eletrônica, Mecatrônica, Automação, Informática, Equipamentos Biomédicos, Odontologia Digital ou áreas correlatas; Experiência com instalação, configuração, suporte ou treinamento técnico de equipamentos e softwares; Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais, redes básicas, acesso remoto, softwares e periféricos; Familiaridade com equipamentos digitais odontológicos será um diferencial; Facilidade para ensinar, orientar e conduzir treinamentos técnicos; Boa comunicação, postura profissional e didática no atendimento ao cliente; Perfil analítico, organizado e proativo; Paciência e capacidade de lidar com diferentes níveis de conhecimento técnico dos usuários; Disponibilidade para viagens; Inglês intermediário para leitura de manuais, softwares e documentações técnicas será um diferencial. O que oferecemos? Ambiente técnico, dinâmico e com aprendizado constante; Contato direto com tecnologias digitais de ponta no setor odontológico; Oportunidade de desenvolvimento técnico e crescimento profissional; Salário fixo + variável; Vale transporte, auxílio alimentação, plano de saúde, plano odontológico e seguro de vida; Trabalho presencial em Goiânia, com atendimentos remotos e deslocamentos técnicos conforme necessidade da área. title: Analista de dho
description: Que bom que você está aqui! Deixa a gente se apresentar... Desejável vivência na gestão de programas de estágio e aprendizagem, conhecimento de LMS, ferramentas de assessment ou People Analytics. Desejável Inglês avançado; Desejável conhecimento ou experiência com SAP; Benefícios: Plano de Saúde isento de mensalidade para titular e dependentes; Plano odontológico; Ticket alimentação; Refeição na empresa; Total Pass; Transporte Fretado; Auxilio creche; PLR; Seguro de Vida; Convênio com Sesi Clube e Esporte.

title: Gerente fiscal - petz holding
description:
O Grupo Petz Cobasi tem como premissa a pluralidade. Por isso, as diferenças são essenciais para a construção de um ecossistema criativo, inovador e descomplicado. Buscamos um(a) Gerente Fiscal para liderar a área fiscal da companhia, garantindo conformidade tributária, eficiência operacional e suporte estratégico ao negócio.

Responsabilidades

Gerenciar o planejamento tributário da companhia, acompanhando mudanças na legislação e assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e acessórias, com foco em conformidade e eficiência tributária; Garantir a apuração, conciliação, compensação e o recolhimento dos tributos diretos e indiretos, incluindo ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRRF e CSLL; Liderar o fechamento fiscal das operações, incluindo e-commerce, marketplace e importações, assegurando a correta escrituração, a manutenção de regimes especiais e o cumprimento das exigências legais; Atuar como parceiro das áreas de Negócios, Comercial, Logística, Operações e Financeiro, oferecendo suporte técnico em questões fiscais e tributárias, bem como na estruturação de novos modelos de negócio; Coordenar a parametrização e a evolução dos módulos fiscais do ERP, garantindo aderência às mudanças na legislação e conformidade dos processos sistêmicos; Assegurar a regularidade fiscal da companhia, acompanhando certidões negativas, fiscalizações, auditorias e demais demandas dos órgãos competentes; Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e análises tributárias para apoiar a diretoria na tomada de decisão e na identificação de oportunidades de otimização fiscal; Gerenciar, desenvolver e capacitar a equipe fiscal, promovendo a evolução técnica, a melhoria contínua dos processos e a mitigação de riscos tributários.

Requisitos

Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas; Necessário pós-graduação ou MBA em Planejamento Tributário, Direito Tributário e/ou Gestão Financeira; Vivência em empresas do segmento varejista; Sólidos conhecimentos em tributação indireta, com domínio de PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ISS e IPI; Experiência com ICMS Substituição Tributária (ICMS-ST) e processos de ressarcimento (CAT); Conhecimento emconciliação fiscal e contábil, abrangendo apuração, obrigações acessórias e recolhimento de tributos; Vivência em formação de preço de venda, composição de custos e análise dos impactos tributários.

Desejável

Excel em nível avançado; Conhecimento emobrigações acessórias digitais, com atuação em SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições e demais obrigações relacionadas.

Modelo de Atuação

Contratação CLT; Modelo híbrido; Atuação nas unidades do Pari e Vila Lobos, em São Paulo/SP.

title: Supervisor técnico de tubulação
description: Sobre a Gruen Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado. Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes. Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência. Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos. Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras. Supervisor Técnico de Tubulação Atribuições Coordenar e fiscalizar as equipes terceirizadas responsáveis pela montagem de tubulações e equipamentos. Planejar e acompanhar a execução das atividades de campo, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e metas do projeto. Verificar a conformidade dos serviços executados com desenhos, isométricos, especificações técnicas e procedimentos de montagem. Acompanhar a instalação de tubulações, suportes, válvulas, acessórios e equipamentos associados aos sistemas de gás. Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos de Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SSMA/QSMS), promovendo uma cultura de trabalho seguro. Realizar inspeções de campo, identificar desvios e implementar ações corretivas para assegurar a qualidade da execução. Coordenar a interface entre as equipes de engenharia, planejamento, inspeção, segurança, operação e empresas contratadas. Acompanhar testes de pressão, estanqueidade e demais atividades de comissionamento relacionadas aos sistemas de tubulação. Controlar o avanço físico das obras, elaborar relatórios técnicos e registrar ocorrências relevantes. Validar medições dos serviços executados pelas empresas terceirizadas, quando aplicável. Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos durante a execução das atividades, buscando soluções que minimizem impactos no cronograma. title: Overseas pre-sales engineer-brazil
description:
Responsibility:

Solution Development and Customization: Communicate deeply with customers (commercial enterprises, industrial customers, agricultural cooperatives or government agencies) to evaluate their energy needs (such as cost reduction, renewable energy integration or grid stability). Work with internal technical teams to design and propose customized solutions, such as 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems, battery backup (BESS) or hybrid energy projects.

Integrate photovoltaic, energy storage or other technologies according to the customer's specific application scenarios (such as peak shaving, off-grid power supply or frequency regulation services) to ensure the absorption and competitiveness of the solution. Sales and Business Development: Develop and implement solutions sales strategies to achieve company revenue targets, especially in the fast-growing distributed PV and energy storage market in Brazil.

Identify potential customers and sales opportunities, and proactively promote company products and services, such as solutions for the southeast region with high electricity prices or the northeast region with abundant solar resources.

Convert potential customers into actual orders by demonstrating technical advantages and return on investment (ROI). Bridging technology and business Explain the technical details of the solution to customers (such as PV system efficiency, energy storage discharge time) and translate them into business language (cost savings, revenue improvement). Prepare and present professional sales proposals, including technical specifications, financial models (such as payback period calculation) and project benefit analysis.

Submit high-quality proposals on behalf of the company and participate in negotiations in bidding or competition (such as the 2025 energy storage auction). Customer Relationship and After-Sales Support Serve as the customer's primary contact to ensure smooth progress from solution design to project delivery, and provide technical consultation and support. Follow up the progress of project implementation, coordinate with the engineering team, and solve problems that arise during installation or operation.

Provide after-sales service suggestions (such as system upgrades, maintenance plans) to promote long-term cooperation and upsell. Market Analysis and Product Feedback Monitor Brazilian energy market trends, such as policy changes (Law 14.300, ANEEL Energy Storage Specifications), competitor dynamics, and customer demand changes.

Collect customer feedback and work with product development teams to optimize solutions (such as increasing storage capacity or reducing costs). Report market insights to management regularly and recommend new product or service directions. Cross-departmental collaboration Work closely with the technical team to ensure that the solution complies with Brazilian grid standards (such as ONS requirements) and customer expectations.

Coordinate with the finance department to provide financing options (such as BNDES loans or installments) to help customers overcome financial barriers.

Liaise with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of equipment (such as PV modules, batteries). Training and knowledge sharing Provide technical training to sales teams or customers to explain the working principles and advantages of photovoltaic and energy storage systems. Participate in industry events (such as energy exhibitions) to showcase company solutions and build brand influence.

Requirement: Preferred: Direct experience in the field of photovoltaics or energy storage, such as selling 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems or battery energy storage solutions. Participation in project development in the Brazilian market, such as distributed generation or grid integration projects.

São Paulo (SP) Santos (SP)

Venha construir uma ONE cada vez mais diversa, inclusiva e representativa. Estamos ansiosos para ter você a bordo!

title: Data entry specialist
description: This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor. Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you'll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise. Position Overview We're looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect. Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U. S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Veterinary radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote

About Signal PET

Signal PET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.

Role Overview

We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.

Key Responsibilities

Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies. Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports. Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases. Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide. Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects. Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.

Qualifications

Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária. M. V., MSc or M. V., Ph D preferred. 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging. Strong diagnostic and communication skills. Proficient in English (written and spoken). Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented. Comfortable working independently and remotely.

What We Offer

Fully remote role (Brazil-based). Supportive, international team and culture. Full training provided—no prior AI experience required. A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.

*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***

This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to Linked In messages sent to arrange interviews.

Please ensure that you check your Linked In messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.

We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Project manager - civil engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager – Marine Works who is willing to relocate to Africa to lead and oversee consultancy and site supervision activities for port and marine infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will manage project execution from planning through construction supervision, ensuring delivery within scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards.

This role requires strong technical expertise in port infrastructure, stakeholder coordination, contractor management, and on-site supervision experience.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and coordinate port and marine infrastructure projects. Supervise consultancy and site supervision teams during project execution. Monitor construction progress, quality, HSE compliance, and contract performance. Review technical submissions, drawings, method statements, and project documentation. Coordinate with clients, contractors, consultants, and regulatory authorities. Ensure compliance with project specifications, standards, and timelines. Prepare project reports, progress updates, and risk assessments. Support procurement, budgeting, scheduling, and contract administration activities. Lead site meetings and resolve technical and operational issues.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, or related field. Minimum 15 years of experience in port, marine, or infrastructure projects. Proven experience in consultancy and construction/site supervision roles. Strong knowledge of port infrastructure, dredging, quay walls, terminals, and marine works. Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. Excellent communication and reporting skills. Fluent in English Proficiency in project management tools and MS Office. PMP certification or equivalent is an advantage.

Preferred Skills

Leadership and team management Contract administration Risk and schedule management Problem-solving and decision-making Strong HSE awareness
